column1: # Replayed by claude.sh for `claude mcp get agent-director`. One row per set/case: its .stdout, .stderr (optional) and .exit.

# kind: synthetic = written from SR-11.7's markers (no real capture has the case); captured = recorded from the real Claude Code named in the claude column (probe tickets/Ideas/b.ssz/probe/claude-mcp, `get`/`add`/`remove` steps), /home/node scrubbed to @HOME@.
# Paths hold @HOME@, which claude.sh replaces with the case's HOME, so a real capture (scrubbed to that placeholder) drops in unchanged.
# A set is a directory named for a Claude Code version; every set must hold every case.
# The add-*/remove-* rows are not `get` replies: claude.sh does not replay them, a test compares its own add and remove answers with them.
